label: Study identifier
description: Identifier recorded in the example file.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Subject identifier
description: Unique subject identifier repeated across paired records.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Analysis day
description: Recorded analysis day; do not infer a baseline rule from this field alone.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Nominal time point number
description: Ordering code for the nominal sampling time point.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Nominal time point
description: Recorded nominal sampling label.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification. Observed nonmissing values: PREDOSE; POST15M; POST30M; POST1H; POST2H; POST4H; POST6H; POST8H; POST24H.

label: Time since first dose
description: Recorded elapsed time used by the template for time-course displays; source definition needs confirmation.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Analyte label
description: Analyte label for concentration records.
notes: The public example uses the generic label drug.

label: Concentration
description: Recorded observed concentration; missing values and BLQ flags are handled separately. No physical unit was supplied.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Below quantification flag
description: Y identifies below-quantification records in this example; blank is treated as not flagged by the current adapter. Confirm the source convention.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification. Observed nonmissing values: Y.

label: QTcF
description: Recorded absolute Fridericia-corrected QT value; the source ECG aggregation rule is not documented.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Baseline QTcF
description: Supplied subject baseline QTcF; the source baseline derivation is not documented.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Change from baseline QTcF
description: Supplied change from baseline QTcF. Five paired records differ from QTCFAG minus BQTCF by more than 0.11 ms.
notes: The example calculates the analysis response from the paired QTcF values in memory. The supplied CSV values are preserved.

label: Heart rate
description: Recorded heart rate; source aggregation rule not supplied.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Baseline heart rate
description: Supplied baseline heart rate.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Change from baseline heart rate
description: Supplied heart-rate change; small discrepancies from HRAG minus BHR may reflect unrecorded rounding.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification.

label: Treatment regimen label
description: Treatment label containing the dose and schedule.
notes: The public example uses a generic drug label. Dose and schedule are preserved.

label: Analysis visit
description: Recorded cycle/day visit label.
notes: Documented during release preparation from the supplied file and template; not a protocol-verified specification. Observed nonmissing values: Cycle 1 Day 1; Cycle 2 Day 1; Cycle 3 Day 1.
